title: Frappe ERPNext 13.49.0 before 14.0.0, 14.17.2 before 15.124.0, and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions prior to 14.0.0, 15.124.0, and 16.52.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges or portal users, to access Sales Order line item data for orders outside their authorized scope. The vulnerability does not affect confidentiality beyond the ability to read certain sales data and does not impact integrity or availability.
